params.name: subdomain
params.description: Used to scope the request to the specified institution

params.name: location_id
params.description: Used to scope the request to the specified location

params.name: sort
params.description:
Optional comma-separated string of fields to sort on.
Include a leading dash for descending order.

Available fields:
  * id
  * -id
  * updated_at
  * -updated_at

params.name: name
params.description: Filter by patient name

params.name: email
params.description: Filter by patient email

params.name: phone_number
params.description: Filter by patient phone number

params.name: date_of_birth
params.description: Filter by patient date of birth. Must be a parseable date string, recommended format is YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: inactive
params.description: Filter by inactive status. When true, returns only inactive patients. When false, returns only active patients. When not specified, does not filter

params.name: foreign_id
params.description: Filter by the unique patient id from the EHR

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Only return patients updated at or after the specified date/time. Must be a parseable Date, recommended formats are YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss+0000

params.name: new_patient
params.description: Filter patients by new_patient status. When true, returns only new patients with an upcoming appointment. When false, returns only non-new patients. When not specified, returns both regular patients and new patients with upcoming appointments. Patients with the attribute new_patient=true are patients that do not fully exist in the EHR so cannot be used to book appointments. When the patient record is officially created (and read by us) in the EHR, record associations will be created and any new_patient records are deleted.

params.name: non_patient
params.description: Specify if you want to filter non_patients. In case of true: return only non_patients. In case of false: Result does not include non_patients. In case of null: do not set filter/return any

params.name: forms_syncable
params.description: Specify if you want to filter to patients that can have forms inserted into their patient file. In case of true: Return only patients that can have forms inserted into their patient file. In case of false or nil: do not filter

params.name: location_strict
params.description: Only returns patients belonging to the specified location, rather than searching across the EHR system

params.name: start_cursor
params.description: First item of the current page. Starts empty

params.name: end_cursor
params.description: Last item of the current page. Starts empty

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results to return per page. Maximum allowed amount is 1000.

items.docs: This endpoint returns a list of patients for the specified location, narrowed down by the optional filters configured.
